content.content: Redo moves the position to the post-boundary of the next undone operation and steps the undone count one forward, the pairs standing.
content.rationale: The state redo leaves was fixed only inside specs/markers/redo.qnt's `redo` action, so a claim naming it had nothing smaller than the whole model to depend on. T-state fixes the four variables, G-select-redo which post-boundary redo names, and T-redo the model this is read out of. The count steps so a further redo re-applies the next operation and a repeat at nothing-undone refuses; the pairs stand, so redo never truncates the record of what ran.
